name: ShadUI
summary: Avalonia UI library for .NET inspired by shadcn/ui, with themes, dialogs, toasts and a composable sidebar.
description: An Avalonia-based cross-platform UI library for .NET applications, inspired by shadcn/ui and Suki UI Library. Install the ShadUI NuGet package and add ShadTheme in App.xaml to get a default theme plus controls, a dialog system, toast notifications and a composable sidebar. A WebAssembly browser demo offers a component catalog, and a companion app on the Microsoft Store shows usage examples. Free and open source. MIT licensed.
